prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Design desktop section 1 of a two-section CareerAtlas product landing page, 1440x1152. Inspired by official shadcn-vue.com home: centered bold large heading, airy white background, thin gray borders, emerald #047857 CTA, black #17221f typography, system sans. Code-native text and controls, no photography, no decorative illustrations, no metrics. Header logo open-book icon CareerAtlas left, navigation "Product" "Use cases" "Your data" middle, "English" selector and "Sign in" right. Center headline two lines "Your experience." "A story backed by evidence." second line slightly muted dark green. Description "Connect your projects, contributions and skills. Prepare for your next opportunity with a record you can trust." Buttons green "Sign in to get started" arrow and outline "Explore the workflow" down arrow. Below spacious hero, thin horizontal tab line "Record your work" (selected), "Prepare for interviews", "Share selected work". Large static product screenshot inside simple rounded 12px framed area: narrow pale gray sidebar CareerAtlas, Projects, Capture, Preparation, Opportunities, Skills, Profile, Publish. Main area "From work to evidence" top and "Illustrative example" label. Fictional project "Atlas Notes" and personal contribution "Keyboard navigation for project search", confirmed state, personal action "Built keyboard navigation and component tests.", Skills Vue, TypeScript, Accessibility; linked evidence "Component test report". Right quiet mint panel "Ask about this work" with Q "What did Alex contribute?" answer "Alex built keyboard navigation and component tests." citation "1 · Personal contribution". Caption below "Illustrative example. Your records stay private until you publish." Clear realistic app visual, product preview is an image in final landing page, its typography must be readable. Generous whitespace, 64px headline, 18px description, 14px header, content max 1200px. No floating cards, no eyebrow, no gradients. This is only section 1; coordinated section 2 follows.

Use case: ui-mockup. Design desktop section 2 (continuation) of CareerAtlas landing page 1440x1100, white #fff, dark text #17221f, emerald #047857, thin #d7dfda rules, airy shadcn-vue official home styling, system sans, open editorial layout. Top thin rule then left section number "01 — YOUR NEXT STEP" is NOT allowed; no eyebrow labels. Instead simple large left heading "One record. Many next steps." with short paragraph "Build on what you have already done." Then three side-by-side OPEN columns separated by vertical fine rules, no cards: outline book icon, heading "Keep the details that matter", body "Capture project notes, connect skills and evidence, and review AI drafts before confirming."; outline speech bubble icon, heading "Prepare with your own experience", body "Turn selected sources into interview answers. Practice one question at a time and keep useful revisions."; outline share icon, heading "Share the right story", body "Choose fields for each opportunity, publish an independent portfolio, and let visitors explore cited answers." Below wide pale mint #f1f7f4 band with shield icon at left, heading "Your experience. Your decision.", short body "Private by default. AI suggests; you confirm. Publish only what you choose, and revoke access when you need to." Three small check lines "Review before publishing" "Source-linked answers" "Independent opportunity pages". Then centered final CTA region, title "Start with one experience.", body "You do not need a finished resume to begin.", emerald button "Sign in to get started" arrow. Thin divider footer open book CareerAtlas left, small "English · 中文 · 日本語" center and "Built around your evidence." right. Precise 52px section titles, 23px column titles, 16px body, practical HTML/CSS, no invented feature claims, no fake metrics, no cards, no gradients. This is the exact downstream section of a page whose first section includes header hero and wide localized product screenshot.
